title: Residuary penalty.–Whoever contravenes any** [4][rules, regulations, directions or orders] made
text:
45. Residuary penalty.–Whoever contravenes any [rules, regulations, directions or orders] made

under this Act, for the contravention of which no penalty has been separately provided, shall be liable to
pay a [penalty not exceeding one lakh rupees, in addition to compensation to the person affected by such
contravention not exceeding—

(a) ten lakh rupees, by an intermediary, company or body corporate; or

(b) one lakh rupees, by any other person.]
